summary: Frontend + backend persistence testing of new 'plantas por variedad' + 'total de plantas' feature in Nueva/Editar Plantación modal. All 6 scenarios from review_request passed end-to-end.

test_results_detail.total_block_hidden_with_1_variedad: After adding only 'Albion', plant-form-total-plantas not present (PASS)
test_results_detail.total_block_visible_with_2_variedades: After adding 'San Andreas', plant-form-total-plantas appears with valor=2000 (1200+800) (PASS)
test_results_detail.live_update: Changing Albion 1200->1500 updates total to 2300 in real time (PASS)
test_results_detail.remove_variedad: Clicking X on 'San Andreas' chip removes its row AND hides total block (back to 1 var). Quantity excluded from total (PASS)
test_results_detail.save_persistence: Submit creates plantación, modal closes. Reopening in Edit mode pre-populates plant-form-variedad-cantidad-Albion=1200 and plant-form-variedad-cantidad-San Andreas=800; total recalculates to 2000 (PASS)
test_results_detail.label_variedades_count: '· 2 variedades' shown alongside 'Total de plantas de la plantación' (PASS)
test_results_detail.cleanup: DELETE /api/plantaciones/{id} -> 200 {success:true}; subsequent list confirms no TEST_ plantaciones remain

critical_code_review_comments: Total format: total uses toLocaleString('es-ES') which renders 2000 as '2.000' in real browser, but in this Chromium test env it rendered as '2000' (no thousand separator). Locale resolution depends on the build's Intl data; verify in production. Not a functional bug.
Plantaciones.jsx is ~379 lines, still under 700 threshold but PlantacionModal is growing — consider extracting to its own file (PlantacionModal.jsx) for maintainability.

Submit always sets inventario_plantas = totalPlantas. If a user only fills 1 variedad without entering plantas, inventario_plantas will be 0 (overwrites any prior value on edit). Confirm desired semantics for the 1-variedad case.

success_rate.backend: 100% (persistence verified by Edit reopen + cleanup DELETE 200)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_PLANT_VARIEDADES plantación (id 2619e66b-c653-4fbb-bdf9-385fcf3e19a8) and DELETED via API after test. List endpoint confirms 0 TEST_ plantaciones remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature 'plantas por variedad + total condicional (>=2 vars)' is fully working in /dashboard/plantaciones modal. Key testids: plantaciones-new-btn, plantacion-modal, plant-form-nombre, plant-form-lote, plant-form-variedad-input, plant-form-variedad-add, plant-form-variedad-row-<name>, plant-form-variedad-cantidad-<name>, plant-form-total-plantas, plant-form-total-plantas-valor, plant-form-submit. Backend persists plantas_por_variedad (Dict[str,float]) and total_plantas (float) on POST/PUT /api/plantaciones; DELETE /api/plantaciones/{id} works.
